identitySignals: OUSD's Garfield Elementary School project page names 'Swinerton Builders' as the general contractor, matching the agenda's Garfield lease-leaseback contracts
Swinerton has an Oakland, CA office, matching the agenda location; Wikipedia says its construction division operates under the Swinerton Builders brand
Swinerton describes itself as a general contractor, matching OUSD's 'School buildings & construction' category
research.notes: Contact details are for the Oakland regional office, not headquarters. Legal entity name, CA entity number and EIN not confirmed from a registry page, so left null. Swinerton Builders is the construction brand of Swinerton Incorporated.

profile.summary: Swinerton is a construction company that provides general contracting services, from small tenant improvements to large buildings and medical campuses. Founded in 1888, it says it is 100% employee-owned and works through regional offices across the United States.

sources.title: Garfield Elementary School - Oakland Unified School District

review.notes: OUSD's Garfield Elementary project page lists Swinerton Builders (linking to swinerton.com) as general contractor, matching the agenda contracts. The Swinerton homepage supports the summary (general contractor, founded 1888, 100% employee-owned, 24 regional offices) and the Oakland office page supports the address and phone.
